€1, 2. P. Ved. (तकति, तक्ति) 
__1 To fly (as an arrow or bird), rush at or upon; सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः [[Rv. 9. 16. 1.]] 
__2 To laugh at, deride, scoff. 
__3 To bear, endure.
a. Ved. Approaching (गामुक), rushing along; पुरुमेधश्चित् तकबे नरं दात् [[Rv. 9. 97. 52.]]

a. Ved. 
__1 Rushing, darting along; श्रुतं गायत्रं तकवानस्याहम् [[Rv. 1. 120. 6.]] -m. A bird (especially a bird of prey); तक्बा न भूर्णिर्बना सिषक्ति [[Rv. 1. 66. 1.]] 
__2 A fleet horse. 
__3 A thief, rogue.

a. Fraudulent, crafty, rogue. 
-ला A medicament, drug.
m. N. of a disease; [[Av.]] (various Kāṇḍas).

Butter-milk; [[Ms. 8. 326]]; [[Y. 3. 37]], 321; तक्रं शक्रस्य दुर्लभम् [[Subhāṣ.]] 
-Comp. 
-अटः a churning. stick. 
-कूर्चिका Curds from milk boiled with whey. 
-पिण्डः The substance of butter-milk mixed with ¼th of water remaining after making it pass through a piece of cloth; curds; [[Bhāva P. 5. 13. 30.]] 
-सारम् fresh butter.

€1, 5. P. (तक्षति, तक्ष्णोति, तष्ट) 
__1 To chop, cut off, pare, chisel, slice, split; आत्मानं तक्षति ह्येष वनं परशुना यथा Mb; निधाय तक्ष्यते यत्र काष्टे काष्टं स उद्घनः [[Ak.]] 
__2 To [Page0753-1] fashion, shape, form (out of wood &c.). 
__3 To make, create in general. 
__4 To wound, hurt; अन्योन्यं च शरैः क्रुद्धौ ततक्षाते परस्परम् [[Mb. 6. 45. 18.]] 
__5 To invent, form in the mind. 
__6 To make one's own, appropriate. 
__7 To cover. 
__8 To peel. 
__9 To make thin. -With निस् 
__1 to slice out of. 
__2 to form, create.
a. (At the end of comp.) Paring, cutting &c.; also तक्ष; [[Bṛ. S. 87. 20]], 24; also तक्षक q. v.; [[R. 15. 89.]]

[तक्ष् ण्वुल्] 
__1 A carpenter, wood-cutter (whether by caste or profession). 
__2 The chief actor in the prelude of a drama (i. e. the सूत्रधार). 
__3 N. of the architect of the gods. 
__4 N. of one of the principal Nāgas or serpents of the Pātāla, son of Kaśyapa and Kadru (saved at the intercession of the sage Āstika from being burnt down in the serpent-sacrifice performed by king Janamejaya, in which many others of his race were burnt down to ashes).

[तक्ष् भावे-ल्युट्] Paring, cutting; दारवाणां च तक्षणम् [[Ms. 5. 115]]; [[Y. 1. 185.]] 
-णी A carpenter's adze.

m. [तक्ष्-कनिन्] 
__1 A carpenter, wood-cutter (whether by caste or profession); तक्षा रिष्टं रुतं भिषग् [[Rv. 9. 112. 1]]; तक्षाणः पलगण्डाश्च … [[Śiva B. 31. 18]]; अताक्षा तक्षा [[K. P.]] ‘one not a तक्षन् by caste is called तक्षन् when he acts like or follows the profession of a तक्षन (carpenter); [[Śi. 12. 25.]] 
__2 N. of the architect of the gods.

ताक्षण्यः,
ताक्ष्णः The son of a carpenter.
